source.name: OpenEI submission 910 archive / SZVAV.csv
source.nature: The downloaded inventory identifies SZVAV as a FLEXLAB X3A controlled test-cell experiment; the OpenEI page summary also describes the collection as AFDD simulation data. This is not an operational-building trial.
source.signals: 1-minute temperature, occupancy, fan and requested actuator commands; no measured damper position or airflow

limitations: Control commands are not actual damper position; mixing alarms also admit sensor or return/exhaust-path causes.

next_actions.instruction: Synchronously recheck OA/RA/MA temperatures in the flagged occupied window; verify sensor placement and mixing uniformity.
With site authorization, compare requested OA/RA commands with independent physical stroke/position response; do not use control command as actual feedback.
